result: An explicit 4x4 local coordinate cut of the 9x9 PPT crosshatch tensor has a nine-term SR<=2 decomposition, a ten-projector partial-transpose PSD certificate, and a rational entanglement witness. Its Schmidt number is exactly2. The witness is 1-block-positive but explicitly NOT 2-block-positive, so this is NOT the requested 4x4 SN>=3 witness.
source_and_cut: Let Q=[|10>+|02>]+[|20>+|12>]+[|00>+|21>]+[|01>+|22>] as in https://arxiv.org/html/2402.12966v1 Figure 1. Reorder Q tensor Q to Alice=(A1,A2), Bob=(B1,B2), with composite index 3a1+a2 or 3b1+b2. Select Alice indices (0,2,5,7) and Bob indices (0,1,5,6), relabeling each selected set 0,1,2,3 in that order. The unnormalized output R has trace14. Both source and cut are PPT; source Q^Gamma is an explicit sum of four projectors as in frontier-20261028-crosshatch-coordinate-sn2-v1.json SHA256 9071fcc25e96f25e4e6dd96ba38403407fb86fc83e00898687114a700f061d8f.
independent_ppt_decomposition: Directly, R^Gamma=[|23>+|10>+|01>]+[|12>+|30>]+[|03>+|32>]+[|20>]+[|13>]+[|21>]+[|00>]+[|11>]+[|02>]+[|33>]. This is PSD, regardless of the rank of any individual PT summand.
rational_witness: Use zero-based realignment indices Rl(X)_(4a+c,4b+d)=X_(4a+b,4c+d). Let Z be the real 16x16 matrix whose block on rows and columns (0,5,10,15) is Y=(1/10)*[[3,4,4,3],[3,4,4,3],[4,2,-8,4],[4,-8,2,4]], whose other nonzero entries are Z_(1,1)=Z_(2,13)=Z_(3,11)=Z_(4,4)=Z_(6,12)=Z_(7,2)=Z_(8,7)=Z_(9,3)=Z_(12,14)=Z_(13,8)=1, and whose remaining entries vanish. Define C=(Rl^(-1)(Z)+Rl^(-1)(Z)^T)/2 and W=I_16-C. The exact checker verifies ZZ^T is a nonzero orthogonal projection, so ||Z||_op=1. For any product ket a tensor b, ||Rl([a tensor b])||_1=||a||^2*||b||^2; by trace-norm duality, <a tensor b|W|a tensor b> >=0. Thus W is an explicit rational 1-block-positive entanglement witness. Exact contraction gives tr(W R)=-4/5, so tr(W R/14)=-2/35<0; the output is entangled and has SN exactly2.
not_a_target_witness: The SR2 ket |02>+|33> satisfies <02+33|W|02+33>=-4/5. Therefore W is not 2-block-positive and cannot certify Schmidt number3. This exact negative control prevents confusing an entanglement witness with the user's requested high-Schmidt witness.

exact_check.observed: Integer/Fraction arithmetic verifies all256 entries of the source coordinate cut against the nine displayed projectors, all256 entries of its PT against the ten-projector certificate, trace14, rational ZZ^T idempotence, tr(W R)=-4/5, and the negative SR2-ket expectation -4/5. Rank2/product of the displayed kets and the duality argument are elementary written checks.

limits: Only this explicit state and 1-block-positive entanglement witness; no 4x4 SN>=3 state, valid 2-block-positive negative witness, unrestricted theorem, external/formal review or novelty claim.
